notes.title: Vlad Circus: Curse of Asmodeus - OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[p][b]The Curse begins—for real.[/b]
[i]Vlad Circus: Curse of Asmodeus[/i] is [b]OUT NOW[/b] on Steam with a [b]20% launch discount[/b] (limited time).[/p][p]If you want the full tale, look for the [b]Vlad Circus bundle[/b] with [i]Descend into Madness[/i] on supported platforms.[/p][p][b]What you’ll find inside the tent[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Story-first pixel horror[/b] — dread and discovery over cheap jumpscares.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Atmosphere by design[/b] — subtle animations, careful lighting, and sound that crawls under your skin.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Exploration & puzzles[/b] — read the clues, follow the threads, and piece together a past that won’t stay buried.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Journals & secrets[/b] — every note pulls you deeper.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Watch the launch video:[/b] [url="https://bit.ly/vladlaunch"]https://bit.ly/vladlaunch[/url]
[b]Join the community:[/b] [url="https://bit.ly/bfsdiscord"]https://bit.ly/bfsdiscord[/url][/p][p]Thanks for all the wishlists and support—now tell us how long you lasted before the shadows started watching you. Enjoy the show! 🎪[/p]

notes.title: Dev Diary: Crafting the Creepy with Diego
notes.notes: [p]Meet the man who made Vlad Circus this creepy. In our dev diary, Diego walks through the art direction—how mood, color, and subtle animation shape the game’s dread.[/p][p]Launches [b]August 25 (PDT)[/b] / [b]August 26 (AEST)[/b].[/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1567530/Vlad_Circus_Curse_of_Asmodeus/"]Wishlist now[/url][/p][previewyoutube="_3Oa8ov_y38;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: 🎪 The Curse Begins August 25 (PDT) – Mark Your Calendars
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45563918/0f2272b9398d959433e47eca493a34751c001716.png"][/img][/p][p]The fire was only the beginning.[/p][p]In [i]Vlad Circus: Curse of Asmodeus[/i], you step into the broken memories of Josef Petrescu—a man grappling with guilt, grief, and a creeping presence he can’t explain. [/p][p]It’s pixel horror with atmosphere, storytelling, and just enough shadowy corners to make you question your life choices.[/p][p]🗓️ Coming August 25 to Steam
💭 Wishlist it now — Josef could really use the moral support.[/p]
